tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and this applies going forward. Development and local testing use self-signed certificates rather than turning verification off. All traffic uses HTTPS, with no plaintext exception, since certificate management is now in place to support this.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

- Development and local testing use self-signed certificates instead of turning verification off.
- All traffic uses HTTPS, with no plaintext exception.

These come from three recorded decisions: verification on all builds (#31), self-signed certificates for testing (#32), and HTTPS everywhere (#35). I left out the retired options: disabling verification in dev builds and allowing plain http for internal hosts.
